usedFor: Bubble holds what your web app creates, and LeadConnector gets each one as a contact through “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Thing” in Bubble, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A new Bubble thing, such as a sign-up, becomes a LeadConnector contact, updated if one exists.

watchOut: “New Thing” in Bubble is polling, so a contact appears after a scheduled check, not instantly.
